verified_facts.text: The hotel is perched high above the Bangsar district with sweeping views of the city.
verified_facts.excerpt: Perched high above the dynamic Bangsar district, Alila Bangsar offers a calm, contemporary retreat with sweeping views of the city.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is moments from Kuala Lumpur's culinary hotspots, cultural enclaves and main transit lines.

verified_facts.text: Entier serves French plates in a communal dining setting on the 41st floor.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has an outdoor pool.
